name: Dire Fleet Ravager
oracle_text:
Menace, deathtouch
When this creature enters, each player loses a third of their life, rounded up.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, each player loses a third of their life, rounded up.

needs.what: a value expression that divides another value by an arbitrary printed divisor with a printed rounding direction, e.g. {"fraction": {"of": {"life_of": {"binding": "each_player"}}, "divisor": 3, "round": "up"}}, read inside a for_each_player so each player's lose_life amount is ceil(their life / 3)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only division in value_keys is `half` ({"half": {"of": v, "round": "up"|"down"}}), fixed at a divisor of 2; `times`, `minus`, `sum`, `min` and `max` cannot compose an exact ceil(n/3) for every life total, so `lose_life` with `life_of` can only take half or all of a life total
